title: 자켓 같은 걸 좀 입어주면  (What If You Wear a Jacket?)

segments.t: Once everyone leaves the room, Tak Ye-jin switches tactics from scolding to flattery to get a jacket over Cindy's sheer outfit — then steps into the hall to scold Seung-chan all over again. Listen for the words for 'upset' and 'a vicious cycle'.
나는 이 옷이 너무 예쁜데, 아 나 진심 속상해.
자기가 이 옷 입고 방송 나가잖아? 나 방통위 가야 돼.
자켓 같은 걸 좀 입어주면 어떨까?
자켓이 있나?
고마워요!
야, 땡땡이! 너 이름이 뭐니?
죄송합니다!
죄송하단 말은 할 수가 없고, 악순환이네요.
Let's unpack the eight lines of Ye-jin's sweet talk and Seung-chan's catch-twenty-two.
나는 이 옷이 너무 예쁜데, 아 나 진심 속상해.

The word for 'I think this outfit is so pretty, oh I'm genuinely upset.' Alone with Cindy, Ye-jin pivots 180 degrees: she praises the outfit as 'so pretty', then swears she is genuinely upset over the stuffy network rules! Notice the word for.
자기가 이 옷 입고 방송 나가잖아? 나 방통위 가야 돼.

The word for 'You know if you go on air wearing this outfit, I have to go to the Commission.' Here, the friendly term of address means 'you, darling', often used warmly among women. The ending pairs the word 'to go' with 'must' — 'I'll get hauled to the Commission!' It comes from this.
자켓 같은 걸 좀 입어주면 어떨까?

The word for 'How about wearing something like a jacket over it for me?' Instead of ordering a change, she suggests a jacket using a word form that literally means 'if you wear it as a favour for me', softened by a closing question meaning 'how would that be?' It is a handy word.
자켓이 있나?
The word for 'Do we have a jacket?' Flattered that she isn't losing face, Cindy relents with a cool question — musing aloud to herself, 'wonder if there's a jacket around?' This short for that.
고마워요!

The word for 'Thank you!' Beaming in victory, Ye-jin switches to the warm, polite, friendly everyday 'thank you' you will hear constantly alongside the more formal expression This literally means that.
야, 땡땡이! 너 이름이 뭐니?

The word for 'Hey, polka dots! What's your name?' Back in the hall, the sweet smile vanishes! She uses the casual way to ask 'what's your name?', reserved for kids or brand-new juniors — with peers or strangers, you would use a polite or honorific phrasing instead The word doubles the.
죄송합니다!
The word for 'I am very sorry!' Scolded for calling Cindy's outfit pretty earlier, Seung-chan blurts out a formal apology by reflex — forgetting rule number two from this morning! Swap in this word.
죄송하단 말은 할 수가 없고, 악순환이네요.

The word for 'Yet I'm not allowed to say I'm sorry — it's a vicious cycle.' In his deadpan interview, he explains that he cannot say it: scolded if he speaks, scolded if he stays quiet — a true vicious cycle! We built from this. Now let's listen to the whole jacket negotiation and hallway scolding again.
나는 이 옷이 너무 예쁜데, 아 나 진심 속상해.
자기가 이 옷 입고 방송 나가잖아? 나 방통위 가야 돼.
자켓 같은 걸 좀 입어주면 어떨까?
자켓이 있나?
고마워요!
야, 땡땡이! 너 이름이 뭐니?
죄송합니다!
죄송하단 말은 할 수가 없고, 악순환이네요.
You picked up how to say something upsets you, a warm 'thank you', and the word for a no-win loop. Time for the live broadcast!
또 만나요!

lines.fragment: 지금 자기가 이 옷 입고 방송 나가잖아?
이렇게 자켓 같은 걸 좀 입어주면 어떨까?
그렇지만 죄송하단 말은 할 수가 없고
